messages:
Kevin: quick sync — product wants a 'stealth failover' mode (no user-visible errors, route a fraction to fallback when error/latency signals). Need console + API UX for operators: how do they inspect and prove decisions?
Ana: agree. two big asks: (1) billing attribution (who pays when requests get rerouted?), (2) immutable decision log for audits.
Priya: we can tag requests with X-Stealth-Reason and X-Stealth-Variant, plus Trace-Id. console should show split by variant.
Maria: compliance needs tamper-evident audit lines for 180 days. storing payloads full-time is heavy. propose breadcrumb index + sampled full traces.
Priya: breadcrumb schema proposal: timestamp, trace_id, from, to, trigger, latency_ms, score_delta, cost_est_cents. full_trace_sample_rate: 0.02 default. breadcrumbs stored for all.
Kevin: sample policy example:
```json
{
  "mode": "stealth_failover",
  "thresholds": { "p99_latency_ms": 1000, "error_rate_pct": 1.5 },
  "fallthrough": { "target": "compact-1.1", "percent": 25, "hold_ms": 120000 },
  "audit": { "breadcrumb_rate": 1.0, "full_trace_rate": 0.02 }
}
```
Priya: UI: rollout detail should have a 'forensics' tab with mini timeline, a sortable table of breadcrumbs, filters (reason, variant, min latency), and an "export for compliance" button that zips sampled full traces + breadcrumb CSV.
Ana: automation: tie an eval-set run to the rollout: if quality drop > 2 points over 10m then auto-roll back + create visible incident. Also allow cost-drift cap.
Maria: operator controls: slider for percent, numeric triggers, 'force-expose' toggle to make fallback visible for a route, and 'one-click rollback'.
deploy-bot: heads-up: prototype branch for policy-schema and breadcrumb bus goes to staging wed 09:30 PT.
Kevin: action items: Priya - telemetry contract + minimal breadcrumb fields; Ana - billing attribution flow; Maria - compliance export format; Priya & Kevin - console mock for forensics tab. We'll review wed. Thanks!
